Bash(git commit -m "$(cat <<''EOF''
fix(app): Implement lazy loading for Manage Filters article display

The Manage Filters tab was hanging and causing WebSocket timeouts because it was loading and formatting articles for ALL filters immediately on page load. With many filters and articles, this meant hundreds of expensive database queries and citation formatting operations running simultaneously.

Changes:
- Add "Load articles" button inside each filter''s expander
- Only execute database queries when user clicks the button
- Use session state to track which filters have been loaded
- Remove incorrect format_citation import that was causing scoping errors

The tab now loads instantly, and users only pay the cost of loading articles when they actually want to see them for a specific filter.

🤖 Generated with [Claude Code](https://claude.com/claude-code)

Co-Authored-By: Claude <noreply@anthropic.com>
EOF
)")
